pages.text: Stand near an $(l)Infuser$() and a small display rises above it: the offering turning, a ring of mana filling as the infusion runs, and what it is waiting for when it stops.
pages.title: The Infuser's Display

pages.text: Whenever a machine draws from a battery, a pulse of light runs from the battery through the conduits to it. No pulses means no mana is moving: check the batteries are charged and every conduit touches the next.$(br2)The $(l)Research Table$() shows your mana against the cost of study, and a pip for each shard it needs.
pages.title: Mana in Motion
